G_MAINTBIND.form: the maintenance mechanism's bind (THE THIRD FORM): ONE name-only gradient step after every M=25 corpus steps — exactly 16; the batch := ix(16) TRUE install windows (win_i, G_NAMEWIN-gated) drawn from the registered install generator seed 28702 (its own stream; the corpus stream untouched); THE NAME-ONLY CE := mean token-level CE over the masked NAME positions ONLY (7 x 16 = 112; the corpus half of e261's Dmix batch DROPPED — the pure name signal, no corpus dilution); clip 1.0; UNPROJECTED, applied through opt_F (the FACT-side SGD-M momentum 0.9 wd 0, private buffer) at the APPLIED lr_m = min(MAINT_LR_BASE, cap_m) — THE BUDGET-FITTING CAP: cap_m = share_m/||b_m|| with b_m = 0.9*buf_F + g_name the EXACT pending in-step momentum (the event's displacement price lr_m x ||b_m||) and share_m = (BUDGET - S_total)/(1 + remaining corpus steps + later maintenance events) — the SAME equal-share reservation the corpus cap uses, symmetric: every optimizer event's realized displacement fits its share and S_total <= BUDGET by the triangle bound (e286's 89.5% blowout structurally excluded; the arithmetic: 16 steps x ~share ~0.011 = ~0.18 ~= 3.9% of budget)

G_MAINTBIND.budget_fitting_cap: cap_m = ((BUDGET - S_total)/(1 + rem_corpus + rem_maint))/||b_m||; lr_m = min(MAINT_LR_BASE, cap_m); b_m = 0.9*buf_F + g_name (pending_buffer_sqnorm — the exact SGD-M in-step buffer); the realized step norm enters S_maint (the total accounting)
